# The decision list

This reference describes the packs installed in this build of mineworld; a build with other packs generates a different one (`docs/DECISIONS.md` `ARC-90`). It is generated from the types that read each file, so it is never edited by hand.

Which decision model drives each seat, and which memory policy each seat's controller uses: the models this build installs and the parameters each takes.

<a id="decisions"></a>

## `decisions.yaml`

The decision list, at the path `world.yaml` names under `decisions:`; `--decisions FILE` replaces it for one run (`docs/MODULE_SPEC.md` §4.1 states its rules).
Read by the hosts with the models this build installs, never seeded into world state.

Which decision model drives each seat of the world, and which memory policy each seat's controller uses. Every key is optional; with no file every seat is driven by the rule model.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assign` | list of [Assignment](#decisions-assignment) | no | — | — | Which model drives a seat, or every seat of a class. A seat's entry wins over its class's, and a class's over the default; one entry per seat and one per class. |
| `default` | one of `rule` | no | — | — | The model that drives every seat no assignment names. Absent, the rule model. |
| `memory` | [Memory](#decisions-memory) | no | — | — | Which memory policy each seat's controller uses. Absent, the cognition process's own default for every seat. |
| `models` | [`models`](#decisions-models) | no | — | — | The models this file configures, each once, by id: an in-process model's parameters, an out-of-process model's fallback. A model used but not listed runs with its defaults. |

Any other key is refused with `unknown field`, naming the key.

Example:

```yaml
assign:
  - model: rule
    seat: alice
default: rule
memory:
  assign:
    - fallback: consolidate
      parameters:
        calls_per_sim_day: 4
      policy: lm-summarise
      seat: alice
  default:
    policy: consolidate
models:
  rule: {}
```

### Types used above

<a id="decisions-assignment"></a>

#### `Assignment`

One assignment: exactly one of seat and class, and the model.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | text | no | — | — | A class of persons defined in configure/classes.yaml; not person, which default: covers. |
| `model` | one of `rule` | yes | — | — | The model that drives it. |
| `seat` | text | no | — | — | A person of the world listed under seats: in world.yaml. |

<a id="decisions-models"></a>

#### `models`

The models this file configures, each once, by id: an in-process model's parameters, an out-of-process model's fallback. A model used but not listed runs with its defaults.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rule` | [`models.rule`](#decisions-models-rule) | no | — | — | The rule model, which the host runs in process. |

<a id="decisions-models-rule"></a>

#### `models.rule`

The rule model, which the host runs in process.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parameters` | mapping | no | — | — | The rule model's parameters; a key it does not take, or a value outside its bound, is refused. An empty mapping when it takes none. |

<a id="decisions-memory"></a>

#### `Memory`

Which memory policy each seat's controller uses. Passed to the cognition process as written; whether a policy exists is its to judge.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `assign` | list of [MemoryAssignment](#decisions-memoryassignment) | no | — | — | Which policy a seat, or every seat of a class, uses; one entry per seat and one per class. |
| `default` | [MemoryPolicy](#decisions-memorypolicy) | no | — | — | The policy of every seat no memory assignment names. Absent, the cognition process's own default. |

<a id="decisions-memoryassignment"></a>

#### `MemoryAssignment`

One memory assignment: exactly one of seat and class, and the policy.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | text | no | — | — | A class of persons defined in configure/classes.yaml. |
| `fallback` | text | no | — | matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$` | The policy used when this one cannot run. |
| `parameters` | mapping | no | — | — | The policy's parameters, passed through as written: a mapping with text keys and no YAML tags. |
| `policy` | text | yes | — | matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$` | The memory policy's id. |
| `seat` | text | no | — | — | A person of the world listed under seats: in world.yaml. |

<a id="decisions-memorypolicy"></a>

#### `MemoryPolicy`

A memory policy, with its fallback and parameters.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Bounds | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fallback` | text | no | — | matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$` | The policy used when this one cannot run. |
| `parameters` | mapping | no | — | — | The policy's parameters, passed through as written: a mapping with text keys and no YAML tags. |
| `policy` | text | yes | — | matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$` | The memory policy's id. |
